purpose: Planning examples for isolated skill tests, not scored results or reader prose. Select cases relevant to the proposed change.

cases.prompt: Prepare a test of a revised Sky Placement writing skill against the current version. Show the cases, controls and expected cost before running anything paid.
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve canonical and Sky Placement rules in both conditions, freeze the baseline and case set, prepare complete private evidence references, and stop at the paid execution boundary.

cases.prompt: Test a Personal Transit wording change for the existing four-contact You/Friend batch.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use the dedicated preparation and batch contract. Keep You/Friend perspective and exact-contact meaning, model/settings and owner review. Do not add a planner, model judge, extra writer, automatic rewrite or article argument gate.

cases.prompt: Compare a proposed Monthly profile instruction with the saved Monthly version. Weekly currently sounds right.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use the exact saved Monthly profile and scoped corrections, preserve complete evidence, and keep Daily/Weekly/Seasonal settings and saved profiles unchanged. Do not mutate a profile merely to run a comparison.

cases.prompt: B is better overall, but its final paragraph still needs work.
cases.expectedBehavior: Record a scoped preference and the full owner reason. Retain the complete candidate as needs_review. Do not infer exact wording approval, positive voice-evidence eligibility, automatic rewriting or publication authority.

cases.prompt: The judge selected the first displayed draft in both swapped-order reviews. One draft also failed the calculated-date check.
cases.expectedBehavior: Map displayed positions to stable candidate identities, record position inconsistency separately from a tie, retain the factual failure and reject an unsupported usable-winner claim. Request owner review within the existing workflow without a paid retry.
